# PatrolGrid security policy

PatrolGrid has not yet approved a production APK. Until the rollout gates in
`docs/PATROLGRID_ROLLOUT_READINESS.md` are closed, only the protected `main`
branch is in security scope.

Report a suspected vulnerability through this repository's **private
vulnerability reporting** form under **Security → Advisories → Report a
vulnerability**. Do not open a public issue containing exploit details, staff
identity, credentials, patrol routes, mission evidence, or real operational
data. Use synthetic reproduction data only.

This private channel is for coordinated vulnerability disclosure; it is not a
PatrolGrid technical-support desk and must not be used for operational
emergencies. Staff operational issues continue through the normal Department
command, radio, or phone chain.
